description: Counted the trenchers, and kept the threepence.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Set the fish and the price, and told him not to improve it.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Owned the relish, and refused a second reading.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Paid threepence, refused a second reading, and said he had not crossed.
name: William Shakespeare
